analyst_view.overall: Early view: Como come out of the break after a 2-0 defeat at Inter ended a six-game winning run, and they host AEK Athens in the Champions League three days later, so Fabregas may manage minutes. Cagliari stopped a four-game losing run by beating Frosinone 1-0 with a compact, counter-attacking display built on goalkeeper Caprile. Twelve Como players are away with national teams, including Nico Paz and Maximo Perrone with Argentina, which means a long trip back before a Saturday afternoon kick-off.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.6 goals with Como scoring most of them. I lean lower: Como have let in one goal in four home league games and their home matches average under 1.5 goals, while Cagliari under Pisacane sit deep and won their last game 1-0 with Caprile making a string of saves. With AEK Athens on the Tuesday, Como have little reason to chase a rout.

corners.text: The site expects 9.1 corners, nearly six of them Como's. I lean higher because Como average almost eight corners a game in Como and Cagliari concede about 6.5 a game, the second-worst figure in the league. Cagliari's low block against Frosinone gave away 13 corners, and Como will see a lot of the ball here.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.6 cards. I lean lower: Cagliari's games have averaged about 2.4 cards, among the fewest in Serie A, and Como pick up only around one booking a game. A one-sided match in which Cagliari defend in shape rarely turns bad-tempered.

shots.text: The site expects 26.4 shots, 18 of them Como's. I lean slightly higher, because Como's home games have averaged about 29 shots and Cagliari allow close to 19 shots a game. Cagliari themselves took 14 against Frosinone, so they are not entirely passive on the break.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.1 shots on target. I lean a little lower: Como's home games have produced about seven on target, because much of their volume comes from blocked or long efforts against packed defences. Cagliari rarely test keepers away, averaging under five on target, and a rotated Como front line could be less sharp.
